fixture_contract.name: ff-fbs-supply-order-markings-local
fixture_contract.reset: Each case starts a fresh Playwright browser context and intercepts only local FBS workspace and order-markings routes. No live marketplace, database, worker, or external request is allowed.

coverage.requirement: Accepted SGTIN with an exact six-symbol display tail is explained in the existing product/marking context without interrupting next entry.
Non-KIZ, unavailable, malformed, short, or long data is never presented as a KIZ tail.
A failed scan has no false confirmation and cannot leak a tail across a refresh, close, or order change.
Long identity data and a narrow operator viewport retain readable context and usable entry/actions.

cases.title: Accepted SGTIN explains its exact six-symbol KIZ tail
cases.fixture: ff-fbs-supply-order-markings-local: accepted sgtin with display_tail A1B2C3
cases.fixture_builder: Playwright route mocks in frontend/tests-e2e/ff-fbs-supply.spec.ts; fresh browser context per case
cases.external_mode: local routes only; external egress forbidden
preconditions: A FBS workspace contains one order.
GET order markings returns one accepted sgtin record with display_tail exactly A1B2C3.
cases.adjacent_state: Dialog opened; next marking entry control is available.
steps: Open the FBS supply workspace.
Open the order marking dialog.
Wait for the accepted marking record to render.
cases.expected_ui: Exactly `Последние 6 символов КИЗ: A1B2C3` is visible adjacent to the existing marking/product context; it is read-only and the existing entry control remains usable for the next value.
cases.expected_api: N/A: this card consumes the existing GET marking response and adds no request.
cases.expected_db: N/A: rendering performs no database write.
cases.expected_external: N/A: no marketplace call is allowed.
cases.read_back: The rendered label and six symbols equal the accepted fixture value exactly.
cases.reload_assertion: Reopening the dialog against the same accepted fixture shows the same explained tail without an extra action.
cases.oracle: Approved S09 scanner-first interaction contract and S11 product contract.

cases.title: Unavailable or non-exact SGTIN tail is omitted rather than manufactured
cases.fixture: ff-fbs-supply-order-markings-local: accepted sgtin with absent, short, long, and malformed display_tail variants
cases.fixture_builder: Playwright route mocks in frontend/tests-e2e/ff-fbs-supply.spec.ts; parameterized deterministic tail variants
cases.external_mode: local routes only; external egress forbidden
preconditions: A FBS workspace contains one order.
Each run returns an accepted sgtin with one non-displayable tail variant: absent, five symbols, seven symbols, or malformed.
cases.adjacent_state: Dialog opened with one loaded accepted SGTIN record.
steps: Open the order marking dialog for each tail variant.
Inspect the marking context without entering a new value.
cases.expected_ui: The whole KIZ-tail explanatory line is absent. No empty label, placeholder, padding, guessed value, or new truncation appears.
cases.expected_db: N/A: rendering performs no database write.
cases.expected_external: N/A: no marketplace call is allowed.
cases.read_back: No visible KIZ-tail value can be mistaken for a confirmed six-symbol suffix.
cases.reload_assertion: Reloading every invalid fixture preserves omission.
cases.oracle: S09 rule that only an exactly six-symbol accepted KIZ tail is displayable.

cases.title: Rejected or failed entry never becomes a confirmed KIZ tail
cases.fixture: ff-fbs-supply-order-markings-local: existing accepted A1B2C3 followed by PUT failure; repeat with no prior accepted KIZ
cases.fixture_builder: Playwright route mocks return an error for the existing PUT route and deterministic GET records before/after the failed entry
cases.external_mode: local routes only; external egress forbidden
preconditions: One run begins with accepted SGTIN tail A1B2C3; a second begins with no accepted KIZ.
The existing add-marking request fails deterministically.
cases.adjacent_state: Operator has typed a candidate identifier in the existing entry control.
steps: Open the dialog.
Enter a rejected candidate value and invoke the existing add action.
Inspect error feedback and the marking context after recovery.
cases.expected_ui: Existing error feedback is authoritative. The rejected raw value is never rendered as a confirmed tail; a previously confirmed A1B2C3 may remain only if existing lifecycle keeps it, while the no-prior-KIZ run shows no tail line.
cases.expected_api: The existing failed PUT is surfaced; this card adds no API endpoint or retry policy.
cases.expected_db: N/A: no database assertion is introduced by the labeling card.
cases.expected_external: N/A: the failure is locally mocked; no marketplace request is allowed.
cases.read_back: After error recovery, the visible tail, if any, is only the earlier confirmed fixture value and not the rejected input.
cases.reload_assertion: Reload after the failed request renders only the GET-confirmed marking context.
cases.oracle: S09 failure state and S11 prohibition on false confirmation.

cases.title: Rapid consecutive accepted KIZ updates show the latest exact context without a new step
cases.zone: OrderMarkingsDialog / marking context and entry control

cases.fixture_builder: Playwright route mocks sequence local PUT success and subsequent GET marking responses; fresh context per case
cases.external_mode: local routes only; external egress forbidden
preconditions: The dialog starts with an accepted SGTIN tail A1B2C3.
Two existing add/reload cycles succeed and the latest returned record has tail D4E5F6.
cases.adjacent_state: Existing marking entry control is focused/usable before each scan-like entry.
steps: Open the dialog.
Perform two successful existing add flows without an added acknowledgement.
Wait for the second reload and inspect the latest context and entry control.
cases.expected_ui: The latest confirmed context shows exactly `Последние 6 символов КИЗ: D4E5F6`; no stale A1B2C3 is attributed to the latest result, and no new confirmation, duplicate action, toast, or field interrupts the next entry.
cases.expected_api: Only the pre-existing PUT and reload GET sequence occurs; no request is added by this card.
cases.expected_db: N/A: no database assertion is introduced by the labeling card.
cases.expected_external: N/A: no marketplace call is allowed.
cases.read_back: The visible final tail equals D4E5F6 from the last confirmed local GET response.
cases.reload_assertion: An additional GET reload keeps D4E5F6 associated only with its current result.
cases.oracle: S09 rapid consecutive accepted-scan rule and S11 scanner-first product journey.

cases.title: Confirmed KIZ context is cleared when the dialog closes or another order is opened
cases.fixture: ff-fbs-supply-order-markings-local: order A accepted SGTIN A1B2C3; order B has no displayable KIZ tail
cases.fixture_builder: Playwright route mocks distinguish order IDs and reset dialog state by close/reopen
cases.external_mode: local routes only; external egress forbidden
preconditions: Order A shows accepted tail A1B2C3.
Order B has no accepted KIZ tail.
cases.adjacent_state: Order A marking dialog has rendered its confirmed context.
steps: Open order A markings and verify the confirmed tail.
Close the dialog.
Open order B markings.
Repeat by reopening order A only after a local fixture reset.
cases.expected_ui: A1B2C3 is not retained or shown for order B. Closing removes the old dialog context; any later visible tail comes only from that order's own accepted fixture result.
cases.expected_api: N/A: existing order-scoped GET requests only; no added endpoint.
cases.expected_db: N/A: no database assertion is introduced by the labeling card.
cases.expected_external: N/A: no marketplace call is allowed.
cases.read_back: Order B has no visible tail from order A.
cases.reload_assertion: Reopen after close loads only the selected order's fixture state.
cases.oracle: S09 dialog-close/order-change state and S11 no cross-order leakage rule.

audit_focus: Every S12 acceptance row has at least one GOLD case.
The KIZ wording is asserted only for an accepted exactly-six-symbol SGTIN result.
All cases have deterministic local reset and an S19 planned binding.
No case broadens the card into API, parser, persistence, database, worker, marketplace, print, or authorization work.
